profiles.notes: Common qualification rules for 2027 international undergraduate applications.

requirements.label: GCE A-level · score calculation
requirements.details: Present at least two A2 subjects. Provisional grades may support an application. Sum the eligible A-level grades without repeated subjects, using A*=6, A=5, B=4, C=3, D=2 and E=1.

source.title: UNSW Sydney 2027 international entry table, qualification and programme notes, PDF p. 2

requirements.label: AP · standalone qualification route
requirements.details: UNSW totals three or four AP exam scores of 3 or higher. Supply the College Board score report and evidence of completing senior secondary school, and authorise verification. The 2027 programme table supplies no AP aggregates by degree.

source.title: UNSW Sydney 2027 international entry table, qualification and programme notes, PDF p. 2

requirements.label: AP · possible SAT adjustment
requirements.details: AP exam grades of 4 or 5 may reduce the SAT score required. UNSW can consider up to two AP grades and excludes the Calculus AB subgrade. Authorise College Board verification.
